name_note: Faecousia is a recently created genus name; most genomes GTDB places here already carry the NCBI name Faecousia.

sentences.text: Faecousia is a bacterial genus reported in faecal microbiota surveyed by 16S rRNA gene sequencing.
A case-control study of post-weaning dairy calves reported Faecousia enriched in diarrheic calves after FDR correction.
A study that sequenced lung tumour and adjacent tissues from patients reported Faecousia among genera more abundant in multiple primary lung cancer.
